title: Perimeter Scholars International (PSI)
about: Perimeter Institute's PSI is a 10-month theoretical physics master's program (September to June) leading to a University of Waterloo master's degree and a Perimeter certificate. Applications are open, with no fee, until 24 January 2027 at 11:59 pm ET.
requirements: Program runs 10 months, from September to June
Graduates receive a University of Waterloo master's degree and a Perimeter certificate
card_alt: Card for Perimeter Scholars International (PSI), a theoretical physics master's program at the Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics in Canada, with applications due 24 Jan 2027.
